# Battery Cell Performance Characterization - Test Dataset B14

## 1. Operating Specifications and Protocol
This experimental report documents the electrochemical cycling, thermal behavior, and
operational parameters for commercial lithium-ion test cells evaluated under laboratory validation protocols.

Notes refer to the voltage field yet omit whether it holds measured data or a placeholder.
Laboratory notes record that energy is reset on step boundaries.
Files contain no time-interval structure around the temperature, rendering sample-point semantics outside scope.
The interval semantics for the power are defined as closed at the start and open at the end.
Notes mention test index indexing but omit the recovery method.

Baseline environmental chamber temperature was maintained at 25.0 C across all test runs.

### 1.1 Detailed Instrumentation and Channel Mapping
Galvanostatic cycling was conducted using an automated multi-channel battery test system.

Channel voltages were calibrated against secondary standards prior to dataset acquisition.

According to the README, operating state in the dataset is obtained exclusively by step_type_column.
Files contain no voltage column or trace, rendering unit semantics for voltage inapplicable.
According to the README, power values are adjusted by the affine map affine(2, 1).

## 2. Archival Summary and End of Report
Validation dataset B14 concluded without hardware interrupt flags.

---
End of Report B14.
